nphi.title: ARILAC – Advancing Regional Integrated Laboratory Capacity for AMR Control
nphi.actor: Africa CDC with African Society for Laboratory Medicine (ASLM)
nphi.with: European Union (Team Europe Initiative on Sustainable Health Security); Ethiopian Public Health Institute and national AMR reference laboratories
nphi.summary: Four-year EU-supported One Health laboratory initiative launched May 2026 to strengthen integrated laboratory-based AMR surveillance and lab capacity in eight AU member states.

nphi.title: Support to Chad's National Public Health Institute (INSAPT) within PASST3
nphi.with: Institut National de Santé Publique du Tchad (INSAPT); African and European NPHIs (not named)
nphi.summary: A four-year project funded by AFD and the EU and implemented by Expertise France to build INSAPT's core functions, its links with African and European NPHIs, and its data science and digital health capacity.

nphi.title: Africa CDC Central Africa Regional Collaborating Centre (Libreville)
nphi.with: Government of Gabon (host of Central Africa RCC, Libreville)
nphi.summary: Africa CDC operationalised its Central Africa RCC in Libreville in 2017, with Gabon providing offices, an emergency operations centre and biosafety labs to serve nine Central African states.

nphi.title: German Biosecurity Programme – African and North African partner countries
nphi.actor: Robert Koch Institute with Bundeswehr Institute of Microbiology, Friedrich-Loeffler-Institut and BNITM
nphi.with: Partner-country laboratories and health authorities; GIZ; German Federal Foreign Office (funder)
nphi.summary: Federal Foreign Office programme (since 2013) in which RKI, IMB, FLI, BNITM and GIZ strengthen biosafety, biosecurity and detection of dangerous pathogens in partner countries; the 2023 flyer lists these African partners alongside others…

nphi.title: TB-COVID – COVID-19 impact on TB programmes in West and Central Africa
nphi.with: WHO Global TB Programme; WHO/TDR; WARN-TB/CARN-TB; HISP, University of Oslo (Norway)
nphi.summary: Built NTP capacity to monitor and mitigate COVID-19 disruption to TB services via a framework, DHIS2 package and preparedness plans.
